card.name: Words completing 'become evident' or 'occur to me'
card.fires_on: The word right after a verb or adjective of becoming known or coming to mind, such as 'become evident', 'not clear to', 'occurred to', 'crossed my mind'. Found in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Becoming clear
modes.description: Adjective or preposition after 'become', 'becoming' or 'not clear' that introduces who or what is clear.
modes.example: as has now become<< evident>>, the government’s deeply corrupted regulatory arm

modes.label: Crossing the mind
modes.description: Mind or 'to' after 'crossed my/our' or 'occurred' in the sense of a thought arising.
modes.example: It never occurred<< to>> me that statements taken under duress would

modes.label: Coming forth
modes.description: Preposition or verb after 'issued', 'appeared' or 'born' describing something coming out of a source.
modes.example: before the close of the year there issued<< from>> the office of Milwaukee's newly founded newspaper

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, perhaps a push toward a following clause or noun phrase.
card.plain: It fires on words in phrases like 'it became clear' or 'it never occurred to me', where something comes to light or to mind.
evidence: as has now become<< evident>>, the government’s deeply corrupted regulatory arm
These were some of the doubts that crossed our<< minds>>.
It never occurred<< to>> me that statements taken under duress would
